description: This file defines the MultiSelectedActionModeCallback class, which implements the ActionMode.Callback interface for handling multi-selection contextual actions in an Android notes application. It manages actions such as delete, move, share, and categorize notes, and interacts with ViewModel, UI components, and external activities.

classes.name: MultiSelectedActionModeCallback
classes.description: Implements contextual multi-selection actions for notes, including delete, move, share, and categorize functionalities, with UI updates and ViewModel interactions.

methods.name: MultiSelectedActionModeCallback
methods.description: Constructor initializing callback with context, view, ViewModel, and other dependencies, and setting theme color.

methods.name: onCreateActionMode
methods.description: Inflates the contextual menu and sets icon tints based on theme color.

methods.name: onPrepareActionMode
methods.description: Prepares the action mode; returns false indicating no updates needed.

methods.name: onActionItemClicked
methods.description: Handles actions for delete, move, share, and categorize menu items, updating UI and data accordingly.

methods.name: onDestroyActionMode
methods.description: Cleans up when action mode is destroyed, clearing selections.
